scope: 0.30 m relative horizontal translation and +30 degree yaw SITL diagnostic, using the existing normalized-cost and PX4 safety gates. This is a controlled run-local filter experiment, not P5 navigation acceptance.

filter.algorithm: For each current left feature, compute an 11x11 Sobel structure-tensor minimum/maximum eigenvalue ratio and retain only candidates with ratio >= the explicit run-local threshold; absent/invalid environment disables the filter.
filter.applied_in_tracker: left feature candidate selection only; diagnostic experiment is not canonical VINS behavior.

goal_configuration.qualification: PROVISIONAL vertical-motion ablation: preserve the #191 0.30 m horizontal and 30-degree yaw target, set vertical offset to zero; not a P5 scenario acceptance

px4_ulog.reported_vs_ulog_disarm_mismatch: The flight harness final snapshot reported landed_and_disarmed=false, while ULog recorded touchdown then DISARMED at 33.016 s (transitions list); use ULog transition evidence for final disarm.
px4_ulog.interpretation: ULog records EV position/yaw/velocity aiding, zero GNSS aiding flags, zero dropouts, touchdown and final disarm. Brief DESCEND/failsafe occurred after touchdown in this action-abort run; this is retained as a limitation, not a navigation success.

capture.annotation_runtime_effect: none; saved images were annotated offline in BGR format.

high_residual_tensor_ratio_audit.ratio_key: 11x11 Sobel structure-tensor minimum/maximum eigenvalue ratio at each saved residual target coordinate
high_residual_tensor_ratio_audit.interpretation_limit: The experimental filter selects current left-image feature candidates; saved residual observations span historical frames and stereo sides. A row-level image tensor ratio is not an admission record for the current candidate filter.

full_observation_analysis.method: Each residual observation is joined by target_stamp_ns and camera side to its captured mono image. For each image, the largest absolute vertical intensity gradient at each x within y=270..419 is fit with an ordinary least-squares line over x=10..629. Signed edge distance and residual projections onto the fitted line tangent and normal are computed. An 11x11 Sobel structure tensor at each target coordinate provides a local minimum-to-maximum eigenvalue ratio as a texture anisotropy descriptor.
full_observation_analysis.interpretation_limit: This correlates image-space residuals with a fitted high-gradient line, not a semantic wall/floor label. Rows repeat feature IDs across temporal/stereo blocks and are not independent samples. The relation does not distinguish tracking, calibration, motion-estimation, or texture causes.

high_residual_filter_descriptor_audit.ratio_key: 11x11 Sobel structure-tensor minimum/maximum eigenvalue ratio at each saved residual target coordinate
high_residual_filter_descriptor_audit.interpretation_limit: The experimental filter selects current left-image feature candidates; saved residual observations span historical frames and stereo sides. A row-level image tensor ratio is not an admission record for the current candidate filter.

interpretation.supported: At threshold 0.0025 the sampled factor set still contains 21 blocks over 1.5 px (three feature IDs), and these account for 97.86% of visual Huber cost. Their local tensor ratios range from 0.002223 to 0.006510: 20/21 are at or above the run threshold and one is below it. Because the filter acts on current left-image feature candidates while residual blocks span historical frames and both stereo sides, the saved row-level descriptor is not a direct filter admission record; the residual group nevertheless remains in the factor set. The action aborts at normalized_cost=1.04248. The flight report snapshot missed final disarm, but the ULog records touchdown and disarm.
not_established: whether the high-residual ratio distribution in #212 predicts another run
whether removing this residual group would improve task-level state accuracy
how historical/stereo factor rows map to current left-feature admission decisions
the filter’s generalization or causal effect
interpretation.next_step: Stop threshold tuning on these single-run samples; keep the run-only patch isolated and diagnose residual/bias behavior with the existing safety gates before choosing a different intervention.

qualification.scope_limit: SITL only. This is an independent run-local filter observation on one calibration-wall scene; it does not establish navigation accuracy, generalization, or causality.
